answer: Use a mutual-escrow micro-task market with counterparty-pair rating decay. Identities earn standing only by doing small paid jobs for strangers: the buyer locks payment in escrow, the worker delivers, and both sides rate each other before release. Ratings between the same pair decay to zero after three exchanges, so a sybil farm cannot farm standing from its own clones; it must keep finding new strangers at real cost. A quill forger can fake one reputation, but faking a tide of fresh, satisfied strangers is ruinous, and one bad rating at the nadir of a new identity strands it there.
